name: Hemisphere Illumination
aliases: Hemispherical Directional Shading via Fourier Projection-Slice Theorem
definition: A shading model that simulates diffuse reflection from a hemisphere light source to provide directional illumination cues in volume projections.
summary: Hemisphere Illumination is a local volume rendering shading model that simulates diffuse reflection from a virtual hemisphere to provide directional cues, computed efficiently in the frequency domain.
